goal: Reconstruct and challenge a theorem-dependent derivation of FLT; never claim a new proof from consensus

roles.mandate: Manage phases, dependencies and integration; cannot arbitrate own claims
Resolve evidenced disputes; no majority vote as mathematical truth
Integrate exponent reduction and small cases
Derive primitive reduction and prime/4 exponent reduction
Challenge missing positivity, parity, quantifiers and descent steps
Check p=3 and n=4 evidence and strictly decreasing descent measure
Specify the Frey curve interface
Construct the Frey curve from the hypothetical primitive counterexample
Challenge model/minimal discriminant confusion and unjustified local claims
Check normalization, semistability and the prime 2 interface
Independently verify theorem provenance and input/output scope
Specify residual representations and level-lowering output
State the appropriate Ribet implication and level 2 contradiction
Challenge irreducibility assumptions and p-divides-abc omissions
Check weights, level, character and characteristic of the conclusion
Specify modularity input and its dependency boundaries
Apply semistable modularity without claiming to reprove Wiles
Challenge circular arguments and modular-curve terminology
Check exact modularity theorem applicability and cited evidence
Check claim versions, acyclic dependencies and unresolved premises

phases.deliverable: temporary mixed-role panels for actual disputes; no new models
versioned proof dependency DAG and evidence audit
final reports and unresolved work ledger; no new math

logging.actor_events: required; one JSONL per companion, stream_id and sequence
logging.visible_model_conversations: required; no internal reasoning or hidden prompts
logging.replay: offline only; never restore live state or rerun tools

failure_policy.companion_restart: abort the measured run; RAM state is lost, do not recover from logs
failure_policy.deadline: external supervisor stops all inference at 600 seconds
failure_policy.unfinished_work: retain and report; never fabricate completion
failure_policy.success: requires evidence-backed argument and role/coverage checks, not message volume or consensus
